name: Pigment
summary: An enterprise planning platform (FP&A, sales, workforce and supply-chain planning) whose vendor documents two agent paths: a hosted MCP server whose endpoint URL is generated per workspace (no public URL), authenticated by OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, with read-only tools by default, read-write modeling tools in an opt-in advanced mode and vendor-published skills; and a REST API on pigment.app with bearer API keys typed as import or export. Account-bound: a keyless GET on the API answered 401 Bearer invalid_token; the MCP server was not probed because no endpoint is public.

payments.notes: 2026-11-08: no public price list (www.pigment.com/pricing answers 404); a free-trial sign-up page exists. Online MSA (last updated May 21, 2026) 9.3-9.4: fees invoiced per Order Form, paid within thirty days to the vendor's bank account. No surface prices an MCP tool call or API call in money.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-11-08, no credentials: GET pigment.app/api/v1/applications 401, WWW-Authenticate Bearer error=invalid_token; OpenAPI document public (25 paths, bearer API key). The MCP endpoint is per workspace and not public, so none was probed; docs: OAuth 2.1 with DCR, no API keys.

jobs.summary: Vendor's claim for its Analyst Agent: "Generates tailored explanations for every cost center or department, cutting days of manual commentary." Its docs show a mission explaining OPEX variance by GL account and department. Produced inside the vendor's product, not by an MCP tool. Measured by nobody.
